text:
Nora: Quick sync 1 hrs before final planning. We want a social surge for launch: X thread + LinkedIn carousel + 2 follow-ups. Who owns scheduling and monitoring?
Ben: I can run scheduling. Planning to use Buffer for X and Sprout for LinkedIn. Need final copy+assets by Mon EOD.
Ivy: Copy notes: primary CTA = webinar RSVP, secondary = benchmark blog. We'll test 2 hooks: product-first vs benchmark-first.
Diego: Design can do carousel (3 slides), hero card, and one short video clip (6s). Drop brand video brief by today.
Nora: Routing: high-intent replies go to SFDC campaign "Launch_Q2_2026" and queue `sdr-launch`. @LeadsOps can you confirm auto-assign?
LeadsOps: Confirmed. Use lead source = social, campaign = Launch_Q2_2026. Zap will create lead and tag thread-ts.
Ben: Draft schedule (times in UTC):
```
2026-05-12,08:30,linkedin,carousel,slide-1-3
2026-05-12,08:32,x,short,hero-card
2026-05-12,09:00,x,thread-start,thread-1
2026-05-13,10:00,linkedin,followup,card-2
```
Ivy: Short X copy idea: "Production-grade inference for teams: lower cost, consistent latency. Join the launch webinar -> https://redwood.ai/webinar"
Ivy: Thread opener: "We spent 18 months optimizing the serving stack so teams don't have to. Here's what changed 1 ->"
Ben: We'll A/B the X short: version A = feature-led, version B = benchmark-led. Track CTR to webinar, replies, and retweets.
Diego: Asset specs: carousel slides 1080x1080, hero 1200x675, clip 720x1280. Also need alt text for accessibility.
Nora: Pinned replies templates (2):
1) "Thanks! We'll cover latency numbers live. Save your seat: https://redwood.ai/webinar"
2) "Benchmark highlights: faster by ~30% at 1M tokens/day vs baseline. Blog: https://redwood.ai/benchmarks"
Ben: I'll set pinned replies and wire a daily digest to the SDR Slack channel via Zapier.
Ivy: Also adding UTM params: utm_source=x|linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch_q2_2026. Make sure links use shortener.
LeadsOps: We'll filter replies containing "pricing" or "demo" as high-intent. SDRs get DM alerts.
Nora: Action items:
- Ivy: final copy v1 & v2 by Mon 3pm PT
- Diego: assets + alt text by Mon 6pm PT
- Ben: schedule + pinned replies by Tue 9am PT
- LeadsOps: confirm Zap mapping and SDR rota by Tue 5pm PT
Ben: One more ask 1 can we include a lightweight benchmark chart image for thread slide 2? Diego: yes, need raw numbers from eng. @Nora can you get those?
Nora: I'll pull numbers and post in #assets. Reconvene Tue 09:15 PT for final review. :calendar:
